text: Let R be a model at an ordinal stage alpha. For every actual occurrence x, including the empty root, every legal one-point donor type d whose restriction is exactly the type of x, and every permitted cutoff delta, there is an actual occurrence extending x by one fresh point. Its type has exactly the donor's scheme and agrees with d when all labels are capped at delta. The fresh point, extension of the root, scheme equality and cutoff agreement must hold for the same occurrence. Different cutoffs may use different occurrences.
scope: The one-point, cutoff-by-cutoff R1 completion criterion for all models. It asserts neither exact uncapped receiving nor a single occurrence working for all cutoffs. The same frozen target is used for the original gated and subsequent coupled conditional roots. No additional universal extension property is assumed.
